title: 巴基斯坦财长瞄准双B：三大机构最高仅B，离双B还差几档？
speaker: Muhammad Aurangzeb

segments.en: So how effectively is this going to help Pakistan reduce the reliance on bilateral loans? Well we are extremely grateful to our bilateral partners who have helped us through thick and thin with IMF programs, with bilateral support etc.
segments.zh: 那么这将如何有效帮助巴基斯坦减少对双边贷款的依赖？我们非常感激双边伙伴，他们通过IMF项目和双边支持等方式与我们同甘共苦。

segments.en: But the way I look at it we have to move towards sustainability and therefore road to market. And this is also in conjunction of where we are in terms of sovereign ratings because we have just as I was saying earlier we have had three rating upgrades since April last year.
segments.zh: 但在我看来，我们必须走向可持续性，因此要走向市场。这也与我们的主权评级状况相关，正如我之前所说，自去年4月以来我们已经获得三次评级上调。

segments.en: So we have now gotten into a solid B. If we go back 40 years the best in the country has ever had is B+. So if we are very committed to stay the trajectory then if not during this fiscal year, early next fiscal year we should get to B+.
segments.zh: 我们现在已经达到稳固的B级。回顾40年，这个国家的最好评级是B+。如果我们坚定保持这一轨迹，那么即使本财年不行，下财年初我们也应该达到B+。

segments.en: But we are aiming slightly higher this time around to see how we break into the double B category as a sovereign as a country. And therefore the debt sustainability and the external debt and with the right maturity is going to be a very critical enabler to help us with the rating agencies to break into double B.
segments.zh: 但这次我们的目标稍高一些，看看作为主权国家如何进入双B类别。因此，债务可持续性、外债以及合适的期限结构，将是帮助我们获得评级机构认可、进入双B的关键推动因素。

segments.en: Amid this period though you are still in need of financing, where else are you looking for?
segments.zh: 不过在此期间您仍然需要融资，还在寻找哪些其他途径？
